motion_type.piston: Reciprocating linear motion converted to rotation
motion_type.rotary: Direct rotational motion - no conversion needed

combustion_chamber.piston: Fixed chamber in cylinder head, piston varies volume
combustion_chamber.rotary: Chamber moves with rotor, housing stationary

power_pulses.twin_rotor_13b: 3 power strokes per eccentric shaft revolution (6 total faces)

valvetrain.piston: Poppet valves, camshafts, timing chains/belts, springs, lifters
valvetrain.rotary: Ports in housing - NO VALVES, NO CAMSHAFTS, NO TIMING

housing_shape.description: Two-lobed figure traced by a point on a circle rolling around another circle
housing_shape.mathematical_formula: x = e*cos(3θ) + R*cos(θ), y = e*sin(3θ) + R*sin(θ)

rotor_shape.description: Triangle with curved sides of constant width

gear_ratio.explanation: Eccentric shaft rotates 3 times for each rotor rotation

rotor.function: Primary rotating element - creates combustion chambers

rotor_housing.function: Contains rotor, forms combustion chamber walls

side_housings.function: Seal combustion chambers axially, contain bearings
side_housings.material: Cast iron (contact area) in aluminum casting

eccentric_shaft.function: Rotary equivalent of crankshaft - converts rotor motion to output
features: Eccentric lobes (one per rotor, 180° apart for twin-rotor)
Oil passages for rotor bearing lubrication

eccentricity.description: Offset distance from shaft center to lobe center

stationary_gear.function: Fixed gear that rotor's internal gear meshes with
stationary_gear.result: Rotor rotates once for every three shaft rotations

sealing_system.critical_importance: Sealing is THE critical challenge of rotary engines

apex_seals.function: Seal between adjacent combustion chambers at rotor tips

side_seals.function: Seal between rotor faces and side housings
side_seals.location: Six grooves per rotor face (3 inner, 3 outer rings)

corner_seals.function: Seal intersection of apex and side seals
corner_seals.location: Each corner of apex seal groove

oil_seals.function: Control oil metering to combustion area
oil_seals.note: Rotaries consume oil BY DESIGN - it lubricates apex seals

oil_consumption.reason: Metering oil pump injects oil directly to apex seals
oil_consumption.misconception: This is NOT a defect - it's required for seal lubrication

peripheral_port.description: Intake and exhaust ports in rotor housing
peripheral_port.timing_control: Determined by port size and location

side_port.description: Ports in side housings instead of rotor housing
side_port.note: Exhaust exits through side housing - unique to Renesis

street_port.description: Mild enlargement of stock peripheral ports

bridge_port.description: Connecting intake ports with bridge in housing

peripheral_port_conversion.description: Converting side-port to full peripheral port
peripheral_port_conversion.idle_quality: Rough, often requires carburetion or ITBs

ignition_system.why_different: Long, narrow combustion chamber requires different ignition strategy

dual_spark_plugs.reason: Flame must travel further than piston chamber

leading_plug.location: Near trailing edge of exhaust port

timing_considerations.total_advance: Much higher than piston engines (up to 40° BTDC)
timing_considerations.reason: Slower flame propagation in elongated chamber
timing_considerations.split: Leading and trailing timing separately adjustable in tuning

oil_pump.irony: Oil pump uses same principle as engine itself

metering_oil_pump.function: Injects precise amount of oil into combustion chambers
metering_oil_pump.deletion_warning: DO NOT DELETE - apex seal failure will result

unique_issues: Combustion chamber is always exposed to flame (no cooling stroke)
Exhaust port sees constant flow of hot gases
Peripheral exhaust ports create hot spots

solutions.extensive_water_jackets: Rotor and side housings heavily cooled
solutions.oil_cooler: Standard equipment - oil carries significant heat
solutions.rotor_oil_jets: Oil sprayed onto rotor interior for cooling

thermal_efficiency.limitation: Elongated chamber has high surface-to-volume ratio
thermal_efficiency.result: Heat loss to chamber walls is proportionally higher

hydrocarbon_emissions.cause: Unburned fuel trapped in port overlaps and apex seal gaps

skyactiv_r_future.goal: Apply Skyactiv high-compression principles to rotary
skyactiv_r_future.patents: Mazda has filed patents for direct-injection rotary
skyactiv_r_future.speculation: Future rotary may achieve piston-like efficiency
